test_title: PYST 18: SSC CGL 2024 - Reasoning (Held On: 17 Sept, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: In a certain code language, 'OASIS' is written as 'RJTBN' and 'OBESE' is written as 'DTFCN'. How will 'OCCUR’ be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2b15de16d396b52c68424915920e099dae05b94ac6a08cd00b03ee850fcc8e27.png] 

The logic followed here is:

'OASIS' is written as 'RJTBN'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6e810e3d54a2e9d7356a7bc421e310cbb289e8fdb649272d0da6eae387200ef2.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/76a4ec3af87f3eabdf311bc9f2cff0bf319fc906602fcd5178be0f3843da7073.png] 

'OBESE' is written as 'DTFCN'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c2287de3f426334025959e6e05f7fbd1259eef893cc075072abcf0524b22166e.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fbfdbacf87cf571393dac336d0c6c4b7eb20f944022ca4af9d677ab99e267547.png] 

Similarly, '**OCCUR**’ will be written as:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f65d2b536855d10db313251c74c0466d90c342fa2aa9ad61fd178be6ff72be73.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"QVDDN".**
